idea: a lighter weight farther out balances a heavier one close in (weight times distance)
prompt: A clay seesaw game about balance: why a light child far out can balance a heavy child close in.

idea: folds that keep the wings level and the nose weighted make a plane glide farther
prompt: Teach how to fold a paper plane that flies far, in ink and toon.

idea: holding the sun, the ring or the carrier still changes the output speed and direction
prompt: A planetary gear set I can turn by hand: learn why holding a different part still (the sun, the ring or the carrier) changes how fast and which way the output turns.

idea: the bar lengths decide whether a crank turns all the way round or only rocks back and forth
prompt: Make a four-bar linkage I can drag: learn how changing one bar's length turns a crank's full circle into a rocking motion.

idea: a steeper ramp gives the marble more speed, and too much speed makes it fly off the turns
prompt: A marble run on my desk: place ramps so a marble reaches the cup, and learn why a steeper ramp makes it faster but harder to turn.

source: Vibe Coding XR AS2 (idea; our wording)
idea: a balance compares masses: equal masses level the beam
prompt: A balance scale with weights to pick up: find the mystery weight by balancing it, and learn how a scale compares masses.

idea: more pulleys make the pull lighter but you pull more rope for the same lift
prompt: Lift a heavy crate with pulleys: learn why adding pulleys makes it easier to pull, but you have to pull more rope.

idea: a boat floats while the water it pushes aside weighs as much as the boat and its load
prompt: Load a toy boat with coins until it sinks: learn why a boat floats while it pushes away more water than it weighs.

idea: bulbs in series share the voltage and glow dimmer; bulbs in parallel each get the full voltage
prompt: Wire batteries, a switch and bulbs on my desk: learn why bulbs in a row glow dimmer than bulbs side by side.

idea: a magnet's pull gets weaker quickly with distance
prompt: Guide a steel ball through a maze by moving a magnet under it: learn how a magnet's pull gets weaker the farther away it is.

idea: a pendulum's swing time depends on its length, not its weight
prompt: Tune a pendulum so it ticks once a second: learn that its length, not its weight, sets how long each swing takes.

idea: a sail angled to the wind pushes the boat, even across the wind
prompt: Make a low-poly game: steer a little sailboat around a desk-sized island with your hand, collect the floating crates before the timer runs out, and avoid the rocks.

idea: speed, grip and turning: too fast into a bend and the car slides out
prompt: Make me a racing game.

source: Vibe Coding XR AS3 (idea; our wording)
idea: burning methane rearranges atoms into carbon dioxide and water, and needs oxygen
prompt: Make a flame burn by joining molecules with my hands: learn which atoms rearrange when methane burns and why the flame needs oxygen.

idea: acids and bases change an indicator's colour
prompt: Mix drops into cups of red cabbage juice and watch them change colour: learn how acids and bases change the colour.

idea: heating makes particles move faster and break apart from solid to liquid to gas
prompt: Warm and cool a block of ice in my hands and watch its tiny particles: learn what changes between ice, water and steam.

idea: a plant needs water, light and warmth to grow
prompt: Grow a bean plant: find out what it needs, painted.

idea: too little or too much water both harm a plant; light makes it grow toward it
prompt: Water a seedling and turn its light so it grows strong: learn what a plant needs and what happens with too much water.

idea: each material goes to the bin that can turn it into something new
prompt: A voxel sorting game: put rubbish into the right recycling bins and learn why each thing goes where it does.

idea: energy passes from plants to the animals that eat them; removing one link affects the rest
prompt: Build a food chain in a pond: learn how energy passes from plants to animals, and what happens when one link disappears.

idea: blood goes body, right heart, lungs, left heart, body; valves keep it one way
prompt: Squeeze a model heart to pump blood around: learn the order blood takes through the heart's chambers and the lungs.

source: Vibe Coding XR AS1 (idea; our wording)
idea: for every solid without holes, faces minus edges plus corners is two
prompt: Build solids from flat faces and count their parts: discover that faces minus edges plus corners always comes to two.

idea: equal parts of a whole: two quarters make a half
prompt: Share pizzas between friends by cutting slices: learn why two quarters make the same as one half.

idea: a 50-50 chance only shows its pattern over many tries
prompt: Put a cat in a box and open it again and again: learn what a fifty-fifty chance looks like over many tries.

idea: a closer object echoes back sooner
prompt: Make a bat game with sound: hunt moths in the dark by listening to their echoes, and learn why a closer moth echoes back sooner.

idea: a shorter string sounds higher
prompt: Make a music game with sound: pluck strings of different lengths, hear why a shorter string sounds higher, then play a little tune by ear.

idea: pressing a fret shortens the vibrating string and raises the note
prompt: Press frets on a guitar neck to play a short tune: learn how pressing a fret makes a higher note.

idea: the Moon's phase is how much of its sunlit half we see from Earth
prompt: Move the Moon around the Earth with a lamp as the Sun: learn why the Moon seems to change shape.

idea: warmed water evaporates, cools into clouds and falls as rain
prompt: A little world in a glass jar: warm the sea, make clouds and bring the rain back down, and learn the water cycle.

idea: something real about volcanoes (magma, pressure, lava building land)
prompt: make a fun game about volcanoes

idea: something real about space (gravity, orbits, distances)
prompt: a space game for my little brother

idea: water pushes harder the deeper it is
prompt: A forest river I can walk along, where I build a little dam and learn why water pushes harder the deeper it gets.

idea: wind pushing on a tilted kite lifts it
prompt: A windy hilltop I can walk around, where I fly kites and learn how the wind lifts them.

idea: flowing water carrying grit wears rock away over time
prompt: A desert canyon I can walk through, where I learn how flowing water carves the rock over time.

idea: runny lava makes gentle slopes, thick lava makes steep ones; lava builds new land
prompt: An island with a volcano I can walk around: learn how lava builds new land and why some slopes are steep and others gentle.

idea: the planets are tiny and very far apart compared with their sizes
prompt: Walk through the solar system at a scale I can feel: learn how far apart the planets really are.

idea: a food web links plants, insects and birds; each depends on others
prompt: A forest I walk through, finding out who eats whom: learn how a food web connects plants, insects and birds.

idea: columns carry the roof's weight down to the ground; spacing and thickness matter
prompt: Walk around an ancient Greek temple that I build column by column: learn how the columns carry the roof's weight.

idea: a steeper slope and less friction make you go faster
prompt: A snowy slope where I slide down on a board: learn how the steepness and the friction set my speed.

idea: turning blades to face the wind at the right angle gives the most power
prompt: A windy plain with wind turbines I can turn to face the wind: learn how the wind's speed and the blades' angle change the power they make.
